name: Claude Connect
description: Open interactive Claude Code sessions and delegate tasks or research (no Agent SDK).

defaultCwd.description: Default working directory for Claude Code sessions when a tool call omits cwd.

binaryPath.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI binary. Defaults to `claude` on PATH.

idleTurnTimeoutMs.description: Kill a turn if the CLI produces no output for this long. 0 disables the watchdog. Defaults to 120000.
